summary: Full backend + frontend testing for stagruz.pl.ua moving company site. All 8 pytest backend tests passed (root, services list with 8 expected slugs, lead create success, validation for empty/whitespace name & phone, lead listing sorted desc with no _id leakage, persistence). All 22 Playwright frontend checks passed: home loads with brand, lead form submits and shows success state, all 8 service pages render at correct URLs without redirect, all 8 nav pages (/services, /about, /fleet, /gallery, /reviews, /faq, /blog, /contacts) load, blog detail page loads, mobile sticky CTA (tel: link) is visible on 390px viewport, header has all expected nav links. Telegram is correctly mocked: telegram_sent=false in response while lead is saved to MongoDB.

issues: Hero background image clearly shows U-Haul branded American truck with English text ('Where Will U Go Next?', 'uhaul.com', 'Gentle-Ride Van', 'Right Equipment / Lowest Cost'). This is a Ukrainian Poltava moving company — the imagery is off-brand and inappropriate. Replace with a neutral or Ukrainian-context truck/moving photo.

action_items: Replace hero background image with locale-appropriate (non-U-Haul, non-English-branded) moving photo
Optional: tighten validation — currently empty name/phone returns 422 (Pydantic) and whitespace returns 400; both behaviors are acceptable but inconsistent
critical_code_review_comments: send_to_telegram correctly returns False when token/chat_id missing — mock behavior matches spec
list_leads excludes Mongo _id via projection — good
Lead model uses uuid string id and ISO datetime stored as string — clean
CORS allow_origins falls back to '*' which is fine for preview but should be tightened in production
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_-prefixed leads via API during testing; harmless persistent data in test_database.leads
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers root, services, leads CRUD/validation. Frontend covered all 8 service slugs and navigation. Telegram remains mocked (env tokens empty). Hero image is the only flagged content issue.
